expectations.text: Produces complete, self-contained working code for the described task
expectations.evidence: Full code for types.ts, selection.ts, api.ts, useBulkAction.ts, BulkActionsBar.tsx, DocumentsTable.tsx with all imports and interconnections

expectations.text: Produces actual working component code rather than only a list of recommendations
expectations.evidence: Complete React component implementations with hooks, state logic, and render logic—not pseudo-code or recommendations

expectations.text: Makes the destructive action recoverable rather than relying on a confirmation dialog alone
expectations.evidence: Soft-delete to 30-day trash + undoBatch(batchId) in useBulkAction.ts; toast shows 'Restored {affected} documents' with Undo button

expectations.text: Shows the count of affected items before the action is taken
expectations.evidence: BulkActionsBar displays scope with count at top: '{scope}' (either 'all X matching documents' or 'X selected documents'); shown before delete confirmation

expectations.text: Distinguishes select-all-on-page from select-all-matching rather than conflating them
expectations.evidence: Selection discriminated union with mode:'ids' vs mode:'all-matching'; togglePage only selects page; selectAllMatching is separate explicit action; comment: 'Header checkbox only ever means this page'

expectations.text: Separates the destructive action from the benign one visually or spatially
expectations.evidence: Archive: filled dark bg-slate-800; Delete: red outline only; visual separator span with mx-2 h-5 w-px bg-slate-300 between them

expectations.text: Does not make the destructive action the default focus or primary button
expectations.evidence: Archive is primary-styled (filled dark button with ml-auto); Delete is outline-only secondary style; Archive is benign, Delete is destructive

expectations.text: Notes that the server must enforce the rules, not just the UI
expectations.evidence: Closing note states: 'the idempotency key must be unique-constrained per (user, key)' and 'filter target must be tenant-scoped server-side, not trusted from client'

expectations.text: Closes by naming which misuses the design makes impossible
expectations.evidence: Closing section lists: acting on ambiguous all, double submission, stale selection, mis-clicking Delete; includes 'Left possible on purpose' rationale
